headline: Across media, gaming, publishing and education, firms show mixed performance with selective growth, cost pressures and varied tech spending.
summary: Media giants post revenue growth but face mixed margins and AI experiments. Gaming operators see revenue gains for some while margins compress and debt reduction dominates. Publishers balance AI partnerships with earnings misses. Education players expand digital credentials but also cut staff and face uncertain tech budgets.

industries.summary: Disney reports 8% revenue growth and strong AI initiatives. WBD/Skydance shows modest revenue growth but tighter IT spend. Versant adds FAST channels and platform revenue lifts. Smaller players report neutral or unclear sentiment.

leaders.why: Highest quarterly revenue at $25,947 m and strong AI/tech rollout

laggards.why: Low operating margin (5.2%) and tightening IT outlook

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Companies launch AI search, trip‑planning and AI‑enhanced content tools.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Hulu app retirement, FAST channel additions and streaming memberships expand digital reach.

themes.title: Cost pressure
themes.detail: Skydance staff buyouts and tighter IT spend signal cost‑cutting.

industries.it_note: Tech teams should prioritize AI pilots for Disney while monitoring cost‑cutting signals at WBD/Skydance.

industries.summary: Caesars posts high revenue but a widened loss; Bally's drives strong top‑line growth; Light & Wonder and Brightstar tighten spending amid debt reduction.

laggards.why: Lowest revenue ($607 m) and tightening IT outlook

themes.title: Digital revenue growth
themes.detail: Digital EBITDA and revenue up YoY for Caesars and Bally's.

themes.title: Cost‑cutting and debt reduction
themes.detail: Light & Wonder and Brightstar focus on leverage reduction and debt cuts.

themes.title: AI support claims
themes.detail: Caesars says AI will support in‑person meetings but not replace them.

industries.it_note: Balance support for digital expansion at Caesars and Bally's with tighter budgeting for Light & Wonder and Brightstar.

industries.summary: Wolters Kluwer expands via AI partnership and acquisition; Scholastic misses revenue and posts a large loss; Pearson shows accelerated growth and expands credentialing.

laggards.why: Revenue miss and deep operating loss (-42.5%)
